items.title: WorldCraft: From Camera Navigation to Object Manipulation in Interactive Video World Models
items.summary: WorldCraft extends interactive video world models to enable object-level trajectory control while maintaining camera navigation capabilities through specialized control pipelines.

items.title: Optical Reasoning: Rethinking Images as an Expressive Reasoning Medium Beyond Text
items.summary: Optical reasoning uses images as a standalone reasoning medium for language and multimodal tasks, achieving higher token efficiency than traditional text-based approaches.

items.title: OASIS: From Simulation Data Collection to Real-World Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: A simulation-data-driven framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that uses 3D generative models to create realistic assets and hierarchical visuomotor policies trained on simulated data achieves better zero-shot performance than real-robot training.

items.title: ResearchClawBench: A Benchmark for End-to-End Autonomous Scientific Research
items.summary: ResearchClawBench evaluates autonomous scientific research capabilities across 40 tasks from 10 domains using expert-curated criteria and reveals current limitations in re-discovery accuracy among AI agents and LLMs.

items.title: Experience Makes Skillful: Enabling Generalizable Medical Agent Reasoning via Self-Evolving Skill Memory
items.summary: SkeMex is a self-evolving framework that enhances medical agents through structured skill memory, improving long-term clinical reasoning by distinguishing useful experiences and governing memory retention based on contextual utility.

items.title: DuMate-DeepResearch: An Auditable Multi-Agent System with Recursive Search and Rubric-Grounded Reasoning
items.summary: A multi-agent framework for deep research tasks that addresses planning, evidence acquisition, and report synthesis through decoupled components and dynamic optimization mechanisms.

items.title: Honest Lying: Understanding Memory Confabulation in Reflexive Agents
items.summary: Agents relying on self-generated reflections can store confident but incorrect task interpretations, leading to persistent errors despite environment resets, which is identified through a new metric called Reflection Repetition Rate.

items.title: AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
items.summary: AHA-WAM is an asynchronous world-action model that uses dual Diffusion Transformers to enable efficient long-horizon planning and real-time action execution in robotic manipulation tasks.

items.title: Why Muon Outperforms Adam: A Curvature Perspective
items.summary: Muon outperforms Adam in large language model training by reducing curvature penalties through lower normalized directional sharpness, particularly in middle and late training stages, with advantages amplified by data imbalance and heterogeneous curvature.

items.title: Lean4Agent: Formal Modeling and Verification for Agent Workflow and Trajectory
items.summary: Large language models can be equipped with formal verification frameworks using dependent-type languages to improve multi-step workflow reliability and performance.

items.title: TBD-VLA: Temporal Block Diffusion Vision Language Action Model
items.summary: TBD-VLA is a discrete vision-language-action framework that combines block diffusion with autoregressive generation to achieve efficient temporal action modeling and faster inference.

items.title: Where Rectified Flows Leak: Characterising Membership Signals Along the Interpolation Path
items.summary: Rectified Flows retain subtle training data traces that accumulate during training and can be exploited for membership inference attacks.

items.title: Skill-3D: Evolving Scene-Aware Skills for Agentic 3D Spatial Reasoning
items.summary: Skill-3D framework enables agents to learn scene-aware skills through self-evolving memory and skill libraries, improving tool utilization in 3D spatial reasoning tasks.

items.title: A Geometric Account of Activation Steering through Angle-Norm Decomposition
items.summary: Research challenges the assumption that hidden-state norms carry concept-relevant information in language models, demonstrating that concepts are primarily represented in angular structure while norm remains crucial for steering stability and effectiveness across multiple models.

items.title: Whisper Hallucination Detection and Mitigation via Hidden Representation Steering and Sparse AutoEncoders
items.summary: Research demonstrates that hallucinations in Whisper ASR can be detected and reduced using internal representations from audio encoder activations and Sparse AutoEncoder latents, achieving significant hallucination rate reduction with minimal speech transcription degradation.

items.title: Hardening Agent Benchmarks with Adversarial Hacker-Fixer Loops
items.summary: Researchers identify widespread vulnerabilities in agent benchmark verification systems and develop an automated iterative process using LLM agents to create robust verifiers that resist exploitation while maintaining legitimate task performance.

items.title: Text-to-Image Models Need Less from Text Encoders Than You Think
items.summary: Text-to-image models primarily utilize basic text representation aspects like word merging and order rather than complex contextual information encoded in full text embeddings.

items.title: SwiftVR: Real-Time One-Step Generative Video Restoration
items.summary: SwiftVR enables real-time video restoration on consumer GPUs through efficient attention mechanisms and lightweight autoencoding, achieving high frame rates at 4K resolution.

items.title: Reasoning Arena: Trace Tournaments When Verifiable Rewards Fall Short
items.summary: Reasoning Arena improves reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards by using trace tournaments and Bradley-Terry models to generate meaningful gradients from non-diverse reward groups, resulting in faster training and better reasoning performance.

items.title: EMMA: Extracting Multiple physical parameters from Multimodal Data
items.summary: EMMA is a physics-informed multimodal framework that directly recovers dynamical parameters from raw video, audio, and image data using a Liquid Time-Constant network and physics-constrained loss.

items.title: Cosine Misleads: Auxiliary Losses Reshape Vision Language Models, Not Their Latents
items.summary: Research challenges the conventional wisdom in latent visual reasoning by demonstrating that cosine alignment between supervised latents and visual targets negatively correlates with model accuracy, while revealing that answers are decoded downstream from latents rather than within them.

items.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
items.summary: Lookahead Sparse Attention with Neural Memory Indexer reduces GPU memory usage for long-context LLM inference while maintaining accuracy through proactive KV cache management and decoupled training.

items.title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
items.summary: Controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models reveals that memory structure and capacity significantly impact open-domain return performance beyond simple replay fidelity measures.

items.title: Latent Spatial Memory for Video World Models
items.summary: Latent spatial memory for video world models stores 3D scene information directly in diffusion latent space, eliminating pixel-space reconstruction overhead and achieving faster generation with reduced memory usage.

items.title: Human Psychometric Questionnaires Mischaracterize LLM Behavior
items.summary: Human psychometric questionnaires fail to reliably predict LLM behavior in real-world interactions, while generation-based profiling offers superior accuracy for understanding model responses to everyday user queries.

items.title: SWE-Explore: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Explore Repositories
items.summary: SWE-Explore introduces a benchmark for evaluating coding agents' repository exploration capabilities by requiring ranked lists of relevant code regions within line budgets, demonstrating that agentic exploration outperforms traditional retrieval methods.

items.title: SpatialWorld: Benchmarking Interactive Spatial Reasoning of Multimodal Agents in Real-World Tasks
items.summary: SpatialWorld presents a unified benchmark for evaluating interactive spatial understanding in multimodal agents through diverse real-world tasks with partial observability and text-based actions.

items.title: The Distillation Game: Adaptive Attacks & Efficient Defenses
items.summary: Distillation attacks create a trade-off for model providers, where useful outputs also enable imitation, addressed through a minimax game framework with adaptive evaluation and defensive strategies.

items.title: Chiaroscuro Attention: Spending Compute in the Dark
items.summary: CHIAR-Former uses spectral entropy-based routing to dynamically select between DCT, RBF, and self-attention operators, achieving improved efficiency on large text datasets while maintaining performance through hybrid attention mechanisms.

items.title: Answer Presence Drives RAG Rewriting Gains
items.summary: Controlled interventions reveal that gold answer presence in rewritten contexts significantly boosts QA performance, with removal causing substantial F1 drops and injection improving results, while conventional probing methods show fragility to sentinel changes.

items.title: PBSD: Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation for Long-Horizon Credit Assignment
items.summary: Privileged Bayesian Self-Distillation enables fine-grained credit assignment in long-horizon tasks by converting sparse outcome rewards into calibrated turn-level signals through Bayesian evidence scoring and autoregressive decomposition.

items.title: Skill-RM: Unifying Heterogeneous Evaluation Criteria via Agent Skill
items.summary: Skill-RM presents a unified reward modeling framework that treats reward computation as a structured agentic task, enabling dynamic evidence aggregation and consistent evaluation across diverse applications.

items.title: Trajectory-Refined Distillation
items.summary: On-policy distillation suffers from prefix failure where dense token-level supervision creates fragmented gradients; trajectory-refined distillation addresses this by correcting student rollouts at the trajectory level before distillation.

items.title: End-to-End Context Compression at Scale
items.summary: Encoder-decoder compression techniques are improved through architectural search and large-scale pretraining to create Latent Context Language Models that efficiently handle long contexts with better performance and memory usage compared to traditional KV cache methods.

items.title: On the Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: On-policy distillation exhibits distinct parameter space dynamics characterized by relaxed off-principal updates and subspace locking, forming a unique geometric pattern separate from supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

items.title: CIPER: A Unified Framework for Cross-view Image-retrieval and Pose-estimation
items.summary: CIPER is a unified cross-view geo-localization framework that simultaneously performs city-scale retrieval and precise 3-DoF pose estimation using a shared transformer encoder and two-way pose decoder.

items.title: OmniGameArena: A Unified UE5 Benchmark for VLM Game Agents with Improvement Dynamics
items.summary: OmniGameArena presents a unified benchmark for evaluating vision-language model agents in diverse game settings with a reflection-based improvement protocol that tracks performance evolution and skill generalization.

items.title: Bayesian-Agent: Posterior-Guided Skill Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
items.summary: Bayesian-Agent presents a framework that treats reusable skills and SOPs as hypotheses for model success, using Bayesian inference to guide agent behavior and improve task performance through posterior-guided harness optimization.

items.title: EmpiriGraph-Psy: A Dataset and LLM Pipeline for Extracting Empirical Relation Graphs from Psychology Abstracts
items.summary: Variable-centered empirical graph extraction maps psychology abstracts to typed graphs with normalized variables and empirical relations, achieving improved performance through staged pipeline approaches.

items.title: Phase Marginalization for Patch-Grid Instability in Vision Transformers
items.summary: Phase Marginalization is a post-hoc method that addresses phase-dependent instability in Vision Transformers by evaluating structured patch-grid phases and aggregating outputs in the original image coordinate system.

items.title: Liberating LLM Capabilities in Full-Duplex Speech Models
items.summary: A text-first tri-channel speech interface enables real-time interaction with visible text output alongside spoken responses, demonstrating superior performance in full-duplex conversational tasks.

items.title: Reasoning over Grammar: Can Synthetic Linguistic Reasoning Traces Enhance Low-Resource Machine Translation?
items.summary: Large language models can improve translation for low-resource languages through structured linguistic reasoning traces, with the most significant benefits occurring during inference rather than training.

items.title: Self-Evaluation Is Already There: Eliciting Latent Judge Calibration in Base LLMs with Minimal Data
items.summary: Self-Evaluation Elicitation (SEE) method improves model calibration for quality assessment through calibration-coupled reinforcement learning and masked distillation, demonstrating transferable quality evaluation beyond specific judge preferences.

items.title: SlimSearcher: Training Efficiency-Aware Web Agents via Adaptive Reward Gating
items.summary: SlimSearcher is a framework that improves efficiency in deep research agents by combining Pareto-efficient trajectory filtering and adaptive reward shaping to reduce computational costs while maintaining accuracy.

items.title: LatentSkill: From In-Context Textual Skills to In-Weight Latent Skills for LLM Agents
items.summary: LatentSkill enables efficient deployment of textual skills in agent systems by converting them into LoRA adapters stored in weight space, reducing context overhead while maintaining modularity and composability.

items.title: CoVEBench: Can Video Editing Models Handle Complex Instructions?
items.summary: A new benchmark called CoVEBench is introduced to evaluate compositional video editing capabilities, addressing limitations of existing models in handling complex, multi-step editing tasks while preserving spatiotemporal content.

items.title: OmniCap-IF: Benchmarking and Improving Instruction Following Abilities for Omni-Video Captioning
items.summary: OmniCap-IF is introduced as the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating instruction-following capabilities in omni-modal captioning, revealing significant performance disparities and a format-content tradeoff in multi-modal reasoning.

items.title: Set-Based Transformer for Atmospheric Compensation in Standoff LWIR Hyperspectral Imaging
items.summary: A lightweight deep learning framework is presented for atmospheric compensation in passive long-wave infrared hyperspectral imaging, enabling joint estimation of transmittance, atmospheric path radiance, and downwelling spectrum from multi-range radiance measurements.

items.title: PIPE-Cypher: Automatic Enterprise Benchmark Generation for Text-to-Cypher Systems
items.summary: A local benchmark-generation pipeline transforms live property graphs and seed queries into balanced NL-to-Cypher datasets for enterprise knowledge graphs, incorporating schema profiling, reverse-query grounding, and execution validation.

items.title: Evaluation Cards: An Interpretive Layer for AI Evaluation Reporting
items.summary: AI evaluation results suffer from inconsistent reporting across platforms, prompting the development of EvalCards, an operational framework that standardizes benchmark metadata, evaluation data, and model information into a unified, interpretable record with four key interpretive signals.
